```{r import_and_merge_datasets, include=FALSE}
library(haven)

current <- getwd()
while (basename(current) != "Data_center_and_fossil_energy_Replication") {
  current <- dirname(current)
}
base_path <- current

# Sub Path Setting
path_raw     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "raw")
path_temp    <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "temp")
path_use     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "use")
path_figures <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Figures")
path_tables  <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Tables")

# read data
data <- read_dta(file.path(path_use, "forR_placebo_larger_all.dta"))

```


```{r si fig 7 calculation session}
# ============================================================
# Cox Regression: Larger-scale DC Data Centers
# ============================================================
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

distances <- c("25km")
types <- c("larger_all", "other_all")

results_list <- list()
cox_models_list <- list()

# ============================================================
# Create era category variable based on year
# ============================================================
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    era_cat = case_when(
      year < 2006 ~ 1,
      year >= 2006 & year <= 2015 ~ 2,
      year >= 2016 & year <= 2019 ~ 3,
      year >= 2020 & year <= 2025 ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Run Cox Models
# ============================================================
for (dist in distances) {
  
  proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str), 
      data = data,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 100)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
    
    for (i in seq_along(types)) {
      type <- types[i]
      var_name <- proximity_vars[i]
      
      if (has_robust) {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[i, "robust se"]
        pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      } else {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
        pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      }
      
      hr <- exp(coef_val)
      ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
      ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
      
      result_row <- data.frame(
        Distance = dist,
        Type = type,
        Variable = var_name,
        Coefficient = coef_val,
        HR = hr,
        SE = se,
        CI_lower = ci_lower,
        CI_upper = ci_upper,
        P_value = pval,
        Sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          pval < 0.1 ~ "+",
          TRUE ~ ""
        )
      )
      
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- result_row
    }
    
    model_key <- paste0(dist, "_largescale")
    cox_models_list[[model_key]] <- list(
      model = cox_model,
      distance = dist,
      formula = formula_str
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("✓ Successfully fitted Larger-scale DC model for distance: %s\n", dist))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error in distance %s: %s\n", dist, e$message))
  })
}

# ============================================================
# Process Results
# ============================================================
if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted!")
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_num = as.numeric(gsub("km", "", Distance))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Distance_num)

saveRDS(results_df, file.path(path_temp, "large_others_all_results.rds"))
saveRDS(cox_models_list, file.path(path_temp, "large_others_all_models.rds"))
write.csv(results_df, file.path(path_tables, "large_others_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Larger-scale DC Data Centers Analysis Completed ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total distances fitted: %d\n", length(cox_models_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n", sum(results_df$P_value < 0.05)))

print(results_df %>% select(Distance, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig))


```


```{r si Figure 7 plot session}
# ============================================================
# Forest Plot: 25km - Larger-scale DC vs Other
# ============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load results
results_df <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "large_others_all_results.rds"))

# ============================================================
# Nature Standards
# ============================================================
FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.5
POINT_STROKE <- 1.2

# Colors
colors <- c(
  "larger_all" = "#FF4500",   # Larger-scale DC: Orange-red
  "other_all"  = "#FF4500"    # Other: Royal blue
)

# Labels
labels <- c(
  "larger_all" = "Larger-scale DC",
  "other_all"  = "Smaller-scale DC"
)

# Theme
theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      plot.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_TITLE, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_CAPTION,
        hjust = 0,
        color = "grey20",
        margin = margin(t = 8),
        lineheight = 1.1
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(t = 4)
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT,
        color = "black",
        hjust = 1.1,
        vjust = 1.1,
        angle = -30,
        margin = margin(r = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE,
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE,
        angle = 90,
        margin = margin(r = 8)
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 20),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================================
plot_data <- results_df %>%
  filter(Distance == "25km", Type %in% c("larger_all", "other_all")) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_label = labels[Type],
    Type_factor = factor(Type_label, levels = rev(unname(labels))),
    plot_order = case_when(
      Type == "larger_all" ~ 2,
      Type == "other_all" ~ 1
    ),
    hr_label = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

# Calculate x-axis limits
x_min <- min(plot_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min
x_limit_min <- x_min - 0.15 * x_range
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.15 * x_range

# Calculate label positions
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(CI_upper + 0.03 * x_range, x_limit_max - 0.05 * x_range)
  )

# ============================================================
# Create Plot
# ============================================================
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = HR, y = plot_order)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper, color = Type),
    height = 0,
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Type, fill = Type),
    shape = 21,
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, label = hr_label, color = Type),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE,
    family = FONT_FAMILY
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = colors,
    labels = labels,
    name = "Data Center Type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(rep("white", length(colors)), names(colors)),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_min, x_max), n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:2,
    labels = c("Smaller-scale DC", "Larger-scale DC"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Data Centers on Coal Plant Retirement (25 km)",
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Data Center types",
    caption = paste(
      "***p < 0.001, **p < 0.01, *p < 0.05, +p < 0.1",
      "HR > 1: Accelerate retirement; HR < 1: Delay retirement",
      "Larger-scale DC: Hyperscale, Crypto Mining, Wholesale, and Cloud Data Centers",
      "Other: Colocation, Enterprise, and Small Data Centers",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_nature_standard()

# ============================================================
# Save
# ============================================================
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "si_fig7.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)

print(p)
cat("\n✓ Plot saved: si_fig7.pdf\n")

# ============================================================
# Print Results Table
# ============================================================
cat("\n=== Results Summary ===\n")
print(
  plot_data %>%
    select(Type = Type_label, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig) %>%
    mutate(
      CI = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", CI_lower, CI_upper),
      P_value = sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
    ) %>%
    select(Type, HR, CI, P_value, Sig)
)


```
